newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LIETUVOS DRAUDIMAS TO BE TRADED ON BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: LIETUVOS DRAUDIMAS TO BE TRADED ON BOURSE.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Tuesday that its board has decided to list the securities of biggest insurance company Lietuvos Draudimas.

The bourse said in a statement that it decided to allow block trading and central market transactions in Lietuvos Draudimas' 398,760 ordinary shares which have a nominal value of 35 litas from July 14.
The share capital of the company stands at 13.14 million litas, the bourse said.
